subject.title: [Feature]: Select microphones from Talk control and centralize voice settings

question: Should Control UI centralize realtime Talk voice settings in Settings and add browser-local microphone selection from the composer caret?
rationale: The issue is labeled maintainer and changes the user-facing ownership of Talk controls plus microphone permission/device-selection behavior.

options.title: Adopt the requested UX
options.body: Move voice/model/sensitivity ownership to Settings and add browser-local microphone selection in the Talk caret.

options.title: Keep current composer overrides
options.body: Leave Talk overrides in the composer and defer microphone selection until a broader voice-settings design exists.

recommendation.title: Adopt the requested UX
recommendation.body: Move voice/model/sensitivity ownership to Settings and add browser-local microphone selection in the Talk caret.
